Tired of stateless, fragmented AI assistants that forget everything the moment your session ends? 🤖

Meet Hermes Agent by Nous Research—a self-improving, multi-platform AI agent framework built to bridge local environments, serverless backends, and team chat platforms into a single unified powerhouse. 

Here is how it solves the modern AI workflow bottleneck:
⚡️ Closed-Loop Skill Creation: Automatically curates memory, learns new skills after complex tasks, and uses SQLite FTS5 session search to never lose context.
🌐 Multi-Platform Gateway: Deploy seamlessly across Telegram, Discord, Slack, WhatsApp, Signal, and the CLI from one single process.
🛠️ Flexible Backends: Choose from seven terminal backends including Docker, SSH, Modal, and Daytona for secure, serverless persistence.
🔄 Total Model Agnosticism: Switch effortlessly between Nous Portal, OpenRouter, OpenAI, and local endpoints with zero code changes.

Whether you want to automate complex nightly DevOps audits using natural language cron jobs or bridge your CLI directly with team chat apps, Hermes Agent runs anywhere from a cheap VPS to fully serverless infrastructure. 

Check out the repo, deploy your autonomous agent, and drop a star to support open-source AI:
https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent

Ever wondered what a professional Digital Audio Workstation looks like built from scratch in pure Rust? 🎵🦀

SoundCraft is an ambitious clean-room reimplementation of Avid Pro Tools designed to bring high-performance DAW capabilities natively to desktop, web browsers, and AI agents.

For decades, audio software has been plagued by memory safety vulnerabilities and legacy bottlenecks trapped inside massive C++ codebases. SoundCraft solves this by delivering a complete, high-performance audio engine and multitrack editing environment entirely in memory-safe Rust. 

Here is what makes SoundCraft an architectural masterpiece:
⚡ Pure Rust Real-Time Processing: Custom multitrack parallel mix engine, video decoding for H.264 and ProRes, and native synthesis without legacy C++ dependencies.
🔌 Comprehensive Plugin Ecosystem: Supports CLAP, VST3, and Audio Units featuring off-thread instance creation and built-in studio effects.
🤖 AI Agent & CLI Scriptability: Every action, automation lane, and editing command can be driven programmatically by an AI agent or automated script.
🌐 Cross-Platform & WebAssembly: Compiles natively to major desktop operating systems, FreeBSD, and runs seamlessly right inside your web browser via WebAssembly.

Whether you want to build headless audio rendering pipelines driven by AI, study lock-free audio thread communication, or master 120 FPS GUI rendering with egui, SoundCraft is an incredible codebase to explore.

Check out the repository and star the project on GitHub:
https://github.com/storytold/soundcraft

Tired of cloud-dependent search tools that slow down your Mac and compromise your privacy? 

Meet DigUp: a local-first macOS utility that brings semantic, multimodal file and code search directly to your menubar. Powered by Google DeepMind's EmbeddingGemma 2 via llama.cpp and accelerated by Apple Silicon Metal, DigUp runs entirely on-device with zero cloud telemetry.

The Problem It Solves:
Local information retrieval is often fragmented. DigUp bridges the gap by allowing you to search through diverse file types—including text, images, audio, video, and code—using natural language descriptions or exact strings, all indexed neatly into a local SQLite database.

Key Features:
• Multimodal Local Inference: Maps text, images, audio, and video into a shared 768-dimensional space offline using a 740M parameter model.
• Granular Deep Linking: Jump straight to the exact context, whether it is a specific timestamp in a video, a highlighted clause in a PDF, or an exact line of code in VS Code or Zed.
• Dedicated Code Search: Syntax-aware searching for source files and notebooks that respects gitignore rules and handles natural language queries like "retry a failed call with backoff."
• Hybrid Search: Combines vector-based semantic retrieval with exact keyword matching for error codes and names.

Why Developers Will Love It:
DigUp is an exceptional reference implementation for embedding local AI models into native macOS apps using Swift, SwiftUI, and llama.cpp. It is a complete blueprint for building privacy-first, resource-efficient background indexing pipelines with SQLite and Metal hardware acceleration.

Check out the repository and explore the codebase here:
https://github.com/ARahim3/DigUp

Tired of your desktop apps draining gigabytes of RAM just to display a simple UI? Say goodbye to bloated web-wrapper launchers. 

Manage, update, and launch an entire desktop suite from a single, blazing-fast native Rust application without bloating your system with Electron. 🚀

If you are building multi-tool desktop suites, you already know the pain of fragmentation. Keeping track of release pages, manually checking hashes, and wrangling multiple updaters is a massive headache for users and developers alike. 

Enter the ArtCraft Launcher. It acts as a unified central hub that automatically targets your exact OS and CPU architecture, verifies SHA-256 checksums, and handles self-updates seamlessly. 

Here is what makes it a powerhouse for systems programmers and desktop developers:

⚡ Blazing-Fast Native UI: Built entirely in Rust using egui, completely avoiding the memory overhead of Electron.
📦 Intelligent Release Management: Auto-detects your architecture to fetch, verify, and install the right packages (.dmg, .msi, .deb, .rpm, AppImage, or Flatpak).
🌐 Global Localization: Comprehensive localization engine supporting international locales with intelligent CJK font fallback handling.
🛡️ Robust Sandboxing: Advanced fallback behavior on Linux and FreeBSD, supporting both privileged host integration and unprivileged flatpak-spawn or tarball executions.

Whether you need a rock-solid architectural blueprint for your own Rust-based desktop utilities or a clean way to distribute internal tools across developer workstations, this repo is a goldmine.

Check out the source code and start building lightweight native tools today:
https://github.com/storytold/craft-launcher

Transform coding agents into creative directors by programmatically generating complex animations across 35 distinct art styles and 9 explainer grammars. 🎨✨

Are you tired of spending hours on manual timeline editing just to turn technical scripts or data into engaging video content? 

The alchaincyf/huashu-art-motion repository bridges generative art workflows with structured code execution. It functions as a powerful agent skill that allows developers and coding agents to turn abstract data, scripts, or storylines into frame-accurate, motion-driven video animations entirely using code.

Key Features:
• 35 programmatic art-style recipes featuring working Canvas scenes and signature transitions—from cave paintings and Van Gogh brushstrokes to vaporwave and 8-bit pixels.
• 9 explainer-video grammars including Kurzgesagt, Vox-style cutouts, whiteboard progression, and 3Blue1Brown mathematical morphing driven by JSON specifications.
• Automated breakdown scripts and quality gates that map reference animations into beat grids and measure motion heatmaps, stability, and rendering efficiency.
• Long-scroll skeleton architecture allowing characters to walk continuously from left to right across shifting artistic epochs.

Developer Value:
Leverage this repository to programmatically automate the creation of educational videos, technical explainers, and artistic motion assets without relying on manual tools. It provides robust architectural patterns for combining headless browser rendering (Playwright), audio synthesis, and algorithmic canvas drawing into reliable automated pipelines.

Use Cases:
• Automate the generation of programmatic explainer videos and technical presentations directly from JSON data models.
• Empower your AI coding agents with generative art capabilities to dynamically output custom visual assets and video shorts.

Check it out on GitHub:
https://github.com/alchaincyf/huashu-art-motion
